context: Reuse AnonymizationManager._sanitize_public_message / remove_pii for the free-text columns; do not restructure the exporters. The gating rung checks that the CSV/HTML writers consult anonymization at all; tests pin the actual behavior.
description: Found 2026-07-31 during the credential-egress review. ResultExporter anonymizes only the main JSON payload (exporter.py:320) and the .plans/.applied companions (:271-292). Three export surfaces never consult self.anonymize: _export_csv_detailed (exporter.py:515) writes a raw error_message column (:524) - driver error text that can carry DSNs/paths/secret assignments; _export_html_detailed (:579) renders the same data; and the .tuning.json companion (:279-284) is written with no anonymization branch at all. A user who exports with the default anonymize=True and publishes the CSV/HTML alongside the JSON is publishing unsanitized error text. Fix: when anonymize is enabled, route free-text fields (error_message and friends) in CSV/HTML through the anonymizer's message scrubbing, and give .tuning.json an anonymization branch (its tunings_applied content is low-risk but must not remain a silent exception).

preserves.behavior: CSV/HTML column layout unchanged - values are scrubbed, not dropped
